text_excerpt: Violet Austman was the second wife of Anthony Fokker. Biography In July 1927, Violet Austman married Anthony Fokker. The two settled in an apartment on Manhattan's upscale Riverside Drive. But almost as soon as they wed, their marriage began to fall apart. He was always playing the act of being the eccentric multimillionaire Tony Fokker, while Violet began to suffer from depression. In December 1928 she checked into New York's Presbyterian Hospital, where she remained for six weeks and Fokker rarely visited her. On the day she left the hospital, he sent his driver to pick her up. When Fokker finally got home that evening, he was preoccupied, and went right to sleep. In 39 BBY, Lundi, having researched the dark side for years, set out to recover a holocron on Kodai. He was tailed by the Jedi Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi, yet despite this, he almost got the holocron.
